en: Before I opened this shop, I went through
plenty of hardship. I started as an apprentice,
and only now am I a full-fledged craftsman.
See anything you like?
The best tool, you see, is one that's
easy to use. Fancy decorations just
get in the way.
Above all, it has to be easy to use, sturdy,
and free of anything wasteful.
As a bladesmith, someday I want to
become a craftsman they call a "Meister."
That's my goal.
If I become a Meister, my social status
will be recognized as well.
I'll always hold my pride as a bladesmith,
and I intend to keep on working.
Opening the shop on a night like this?
